import datetime, json, os
item = _items[0]["json"]
data = item["script"]
slug = item["slug"]
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + slug
if not os.path.isdir(root):
    raise RuntimeError("project dir missing: " + root)
with open(os.path.join(root, "script.json"), "w") as fh:
    json.dump(data, fh, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
pf = os.path.join(root, "project.json")
proj = json.load(open(pf)) if os.path.exists(pf) else {}
now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"
proj.update({"slug": slug, "status": "script_ready", "updated_at": now})
proj.setdefault("counts", {})["shots"] = sum(len(s["shots"]) for s in data["scenes"])
proj["counts"]["characters"] = len(data["characters"])
proj.setdefault("stages", {})["script"] = {"status": "done", "done_at": now}
with open(pf, "w") as fh:
    json.dump(proj, fh, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
return [{"json": {"ok": True, "slug": slug, "shots": proj["counts"]["shots"], "characters": proj["counts"]["characters"]}}]

import json, os
item = _items[0]["json"]
slug = (item.get("slug") or "").strip()
if not slug:
    raise RuntimeError("no slug in input — Save Script must emit a slug field")
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + slug
with open(os.path.join(root, "script.json")) as fh:
    script = json.load(fh)
jobs = []
for c in script.get("characters", []):
    cid = (c.get("id") or "").strip()
    if not cid:
        continue
    jobs.append({"json": {"char_id": cid, "name": c.get("name") or cid,
                          "visual_description": c.get("visual_description", ""),
                          "style_notes": script.get("style_notes", ""),
                          "slug": slug,
                          "image_model": "google/gemini-3.1-flash-image"}})
if not jobs:
    return [{"json": {"ok": True, "slug": slug, "no_characters": True}}]
return jobs

import base64, glob, os
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + _items[0]["json"]["slug"]
ref_parts = []
for p in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(root, "refs", "ref_*.jpg")))[:3]:
    with open(p, "rb") as fh:
        ref_parts.append({"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(fh.read()).decode("ascii")}})
out = []
for it in _items:
    c = it["json"]
    lines = ["Character reference sheet for a photorealistic film.",
             "Exactly one character in frame: " + c["name"] + ". Full body, standing, relaxed neutral pose, facing the camera, plain light-gray studio background."]
    if ref_parts:
        lines.append("The attached image(s) are identity references for this film; where they show this character, match their face and hair closely.")
    if c.get("visual_description"):
        lines.append("Character sheet: " + c["visual_description"])
    if c.get("style_notes"):
        lines.append("Overall style: " + c["style_notes"])
    lines.append("Photorealistic, even studio lighting, sharp focus. No text, captions, watermarks, or borders.")
    body = {"model": c.get("image_model") or "google/gemini-3.1-flash-image",
            "prompt": "\n".join(lines), "aspect_ratio": "3:4",
            "input_references": ref_parts}
    out.append({"json": {"charId": c["char_id"], "slug": c["slug"], "body": body}})
return out
